answer: A reputation bond resists sybil: to attest or grade, an agent escrows collateral under its public key, and each identity gets pinned to a leaf in a Merkle grove keyed by funding root, so two accounts sharing a wallet land on one branch. Peers run a lantern relay that publishes a clone-correlation proof when duplicate fingerprints collide, and slashing burns the branch's entire stake at once. A farm letting a thousand shells wander the network still posts a thousand escrows; a single detection forfeits all of them, making its loss locked capital times N and unrecoverable.
